scalingFormula: effect*(1+g*ln(1+(L-1)/h)) capped at effectCap; cost*(1+(cap-1)(L-1)/(L-1+ramp)); cooldown*(floor+(1-floor)e^-((L-1)/decay)), min minCooldownSeconds

shield_slam.name: Shield Slam
shield_slam.description: Melee STR strike for {effect} damage: interrupts the target's cast (2s school lockout), slows for 2s and draws monster attention.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: Taunt nearby monsters/bots for {effect}s; guard yourself for 3s.

chain_spark.name: Chain Spark
chain_spark.description: Lightning hits up to 4 nearby enemies for {effect} + INT damage.

frost_bind.name: Frost Bind
frost_bind.description: Frost projectile: {effect} damage and a 35% slow for 4s.

cleaving_strike.name: Cleaving Strike
cleaving_strike.description: Primary-stat strike hits every enemy around you for {effect} damage.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Void-blink to an enemy and strike for {effect} AGI damage. The void rift stuns enemies in the inner circle (1s) and slows those in the outer ring (40%, 2.5s); you mend 5% max health.

restoring_light.name: Restoring Light
restoring_light.description: Cast 1.5s: heal an ally (or yourself) for {effect} + 3x INT.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: Cast 2s: heal nearby allies for {effect} + INT and guard them for 3s.

purify.name: Purify
purify.description: Cast 1s: remove an ally's slow and restore {effect} + INT health.

summoned_wall.name: Runestone Wall
summoned_wall.description: Raise a wall that blocks units and projectiles: {effect} health for 8s.

protection_dome.name: Aegis Dome
protection_dome.description: Place a projectile-blocking dome: {effect} health for 6s.

oathbound_guardian.name: Oathbound Guardian
oathbound_guardian.description: Summon a commandable guardian ({effect} health, 22 damage) for 30s.

spectral_pack.name: Spectral Pack
spectral_pack.description: Summon three spectral hunters that attack your target for {effect} per hit for 18s.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.description: Cast 1.5s: turn an enemy into a harmless critter for {effect}s (half on elites, 3s on champions; bosses and Pack Leaders are immune). Any damage breaks it.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Heal only yourself for {effect}% of your maximum health.

decimating_strike.name: Decimating Strike
decimating_strike.description: Kill the target outright (bosses take {effect} damage; champions take 30% of max health). Enemies within 5m have their armor reduced by 50% for 10s.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: Every 5 minutes your next basic attack is lethal. Bosses take a normal hit (the charge is kept); champions take 30% of their maximum health.

bastion_of_dawn.name: Bastion of Dawn
bastion_of_dawn.description: Heal yourself for {effect}% max health; nearby allies take 40% less damage for 8s.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.description: Blast up to 12 enemies near your target for {effect} + 3.5x INT damage.

executioners_verdict.name: Executioner's Verdict
executioners_verdict.description: Deal {effect} + 3x primary, plus 25% of the target's missing health (bonus capped at 300).

renewal.name: Renewal
renewal.description: Cast 2.5s: cleanse nearby allies' slows and heal each for {effect} + 4x INT.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.description: Clear your slow and heal yourself for {effect}% maximum health.

challenge_of_iron.name: Challenge of Iron
challenge_of_iron.description: Taunt monsters within 8.5m (10s cap) and take 40% less damage for {effect}s.

seismic_reprisal.name: Seismic Reprisal
seismic_reprisal.description: After 0.8s the ground around you bursts for {effect} + 3x primary damage and stuns for 1s.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.description: Aim a 5m circle; after 1.25s deal {effect} + 3.5x primary damage.

spectral_hunt.name: Spectral Hunt
spectral_hunt.description: Three hunters attack your target for 18s, {effect} + 0.4x primary per hit.

mass_aegis.name: Mass Aegis
mass_aegis.description: Cleanse nearby allies' slows and guard them for {effect}s.

wellspring.name: Wellspring
wellspring.description: Cast 2s: heal an ally (or yourself) for {effect} + 4x INT and guard for 5s.

venom_ground.name: Venom Ground
venom_ground.description: Poison circle: {effect} impact damage, then damage over time for 5s.

cinder_cone.name: Cinder Cone
cinder_cone.description: Fire cone: {effect} impact damage, then burning ground for 5s.

grave_line.name: Grave Line
grave_line.description: Shadow line: {effect} impact damage and silences enemies it hits for 2s.

ashen_square.name: Ashen Ward
ashen_square.description: Ash square: {effect} impact damage, then smouldering ground for 4s.

blight_sigil.name: Blight Sigil
blight_sigil.description: Blight sigil: {effect} impact damage; victims receive 50% less healing for 6s.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.description: Long-range piercing shot for {effect} AGI-scaled damage.

silver_shot.name: Silver Shot
silver_shot.description: Aimed silver round: {effect} + 1.6x AGI damage; +60% against undead and void monsters.

hex_mark.name: Hex Mark
hex_mark.description: Put a bounty on an enemy for 12s: it takes {effect}% more damage from every source, and killing it pays bounty gold (25, elites 60, bosses 150).

powder_flask.name: Powder Flask
powder_flask.description: Hurl a powder flask: after a short fuse it bursts for {effect} + 1x AGI fire damage in 2.6m and slows by 35% for 2.5s.

blade_flurry.name: Blade Flurry
blade_flurry.description: Three quick falchion slashes around you, each {effect} + 0.8x AGI damage.

hunters_stride.name: Hunter's Stride
hunters_stride.description: Dash up to 5.5m; your next basic attack within 4s deals {effect}% more damage.

warding_talisman.name: Warding Talisman
warding_talisman.description: Raise the talisman: take {effect}% less damage for 4s and shake off slows.

price_on_every_soul.name: Price on Every Soul
price_on_every_soul.description: Your killing blows pay {effect} bonus gold (x3 elites, x8 bosses) and restore 15 energy.

collect_the_bounty.name: Collect the Bounty
collect_the_bounty.description: Execution shot: {effect} + 3x AGI plus 40% of missing health (bonus capped at 400). Non-boss monsters under 20% health die; a kill refunds half the cooldown and pays a marked bounty twice.

arcane_blunderbuss.name: Arcane Blunderbuss
arcane_blunderbuss.description: A 60-degree cone of arcane shot (5.5m): {effect} + 1.8x INT damage; +40% against casting enemies and interrupts their cast.

spirit_lantern.name: Spirit Lantern
spirit_lantern.description: Set a spirit-lantern trap (20s, up to 2). The first enemy to come within 1.5m sets it off: {effect} + 1x INT damage and a 2s silence within 2.6m.

purge.name: Purge
purge.description: Strip every buff from an enemy and silence it for 2.5s; deals {effect} + 1x INT damage.

banishment.name: Banishment
banishment.description: Exile an enemy for 2s: it cannot act, move or be harmed, then returns for {effect} + 1.5x INT void damage. Bosses resist: silenced and slowed instead.

witchfinders_mark.name: Witchfinder's Mark
witchfinders_mark.description: Mark an enemy for 10s: it is revealed and takes {effect}% more damage, tripled while it casts.

spectral_blade.name: Spectral Blade
spectral_blade.description: Lunge up to 6m with the spectral blade: {effect} + 1.4x INT damage.

witchbane.name: Witchbane
witchbane.description: You deal {effect}% more damage to enemies that are casting, silenced or marked.

hexbane_judgment.name: Hexbane Judgment
hexbane_judgment.description: Aim a 4.5m circle; after 1s it bursts for {effect} + 3x INT damage, strips every buff and silences for 3s.

bouncing_glaive.name: Bouncing Glaive
bouncing_glaive.description: Hurl a glaive that strikes the target and bounces to 4 more enemies within 5m, losing 20% per bounce: {effect} + 1.5x AGI.

sabercat_pounce.name: Sabercat Pounce
sabercat_pounce.description: The sabercat leaps up to 7m and mauls everything within 2.6m on landing: {effect} + 1x AGI and a 40% slow for 2s.

owl_scout.name: Owl Scout
owl_scout.description: Send the owl to a point: enemies within 4.5m are revealed and tracked for 8s, taking {effect}% more damage from you.

moonlit_sprint.name: Moonlit Sprint
moonlit_sprint.description: Sprint under the moon: +{effect}% movement speed for 4s and shake off slows.

crescent_volley.name: Crescent Volley
crescent_volley.description: Loose a crescent glaive that flies 14m in a line and cuts through up to five enemies: {effect} + 1.4x AGI.

sabercat_rake.name: Sabercat Rake
sabercat_rake.description: The sabercat rakes a 70-degree arc in front of you (3.2m): {effect} + 1.2x AGI.

moon_glaive.name: Moon Glaive
moon_glaive.description: Your glaive throws bounce to 2 more enemies within 4.5m, for {effect}% and then 36% damage.

glaive_storm.name: Glaive Storm
glaive_storm.description: A whirling storm of glaives surrounds you for 6s, striking enemies within 4.8m for {effect} + 0.5x AGI every 0.5s.

photon_turret.name: Photon Turret
photon_turret.description: Warp in a turret for 25s ({effect} health, up to 2) that fires energy bolts at enemies within 9.5m: 18 + 0.35x INT every 0.8s.

skitter_swarm.name: Skitter Swarm
skitter_swarm.description: Deploy three skitter bombs (up to 6) that race at the nearest enemies and explode for {effect} + 0.8x INT in 2m.

arc_mine.name: Arc Mine
arc_mine.description: Plant a mine (30s, up to 3): the first enemy within 1.5m detonates it for {effect} + 1.2x INT in 2.4m.

disruption_pylon.name: Disruption Pylon
disruption_pylon.description: Warp in a pylon (15s): enemies inside its 4.5m field deal {effect}% less damage.

phase_lance.name: Phase Lance
phase_lance.description: Fire an energy lance skillshot: {effect} + 1.8x INT damage.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.description: Overcharge your constructs within 12m for 6s: turrets fire {effect}% faster and every construct regains 25% health.

aether_engineering.name: Aether Engineering
aether_engineering.description: Your constructs have {effect}% more health and last 20% longer.

warp_obelisk.name: Warp Obelisk
warp_obelisk.description: Warp in a siege obelisk for 15s ({effect} health): heavy beams at enemies within 13m for 60 + 1x INT, splashing 2m.

aegis_pylon.name: Aegis Pylon
aegis_pylon.description: Warp in a pylon (15s): allies inside its 4.5m field regenerate {effect}% max health per second and take 15% less damage.

haste_pylon.name: Haste Pylon
haste_pylon.description: Warp in a pylon (12s): allies inside its 4.5m field move and attack {effect}% faster.

gravity_pylon.name: Gravity Pylon
gravity_pylon.description: Warp in a pylon (12s): enemies inside its 4.5m field are slowed by {effect}%.

stasis_snare.name: Stasis Snare
stasis_snare.description: Plant a snare (30s, up to 3): the first enemy within 1.5m is locked in stasis for 1.5s and takes {effect} + 0.3x INT damage. Bosses are slowed instead.

aether_mend.name: Aether Mend
aether_mend.description: Cast 1s: mend an ally (or yourself) for {effect} + 2.5x INT.

repulsor_pulse.name: Repulsor Pulse
repulsor_pulse.description: Release a pulse around you: {effect} + 1x INT damage and a 30% slow for 2s to enemies within 3.5m; monsters turn on you briefly.

resonant_lattice.name: Resonant Lattice
resonant_lattice.description: Allies inside your Aegis Pylon or Nexus take a further {effect}% less damage, and your pylons last 20% longer.

aether_nexus.name: Aether Nexus
aether_nexus.description: Warp in a Nexus for 10s: allies inside its 6.5m field take 40% less damage and regenerate {effect}% max health per second; enemies inside are slowed.

bear_maul.name: Gravewood Maul
bear_maul.description: Heavy claw strike generates extra threat against its target.

bear_roar.name: Deepwood Roar
bear_roar.description: A visible cone roar taunts enemies and weakens their next attack.

bear_charge.name: Rootbreaker Charge
bear_charge.description: Telegraphed short rush stops at a blocking wall and stuns the first enemy.

bear_hibernate.name: Ironroot Slumber
bear_hibernate.description: Channel self-healing while stationary; taking damage can interrupt it.

bear_ancient_hide.name: Ancient Hide
bear_ancient_hide.description: After sustained incoming attacks gain a short defensive hide buff.

bear_colossus.name: Elder of the Deepwood
bear_colossus.description: Temporary larger bear form increases threat and defensive reach.

paladin_righteous_flail.name: Righteous Flail
paladin_righteous_flail.description: Shield relic anchors a short flail cleave that marks threatened enemies.

paladin_relic_vow.name: Relic Vow
paladin_relic_vow.description: Bind a consenting ally to the relic for temporary shared protection.

paladin_holy_flail.name: Merciful Censer
paladin_holy_flail.description: Flail impact releases a healing pulse around the struck hostile target.

paladin_pilgrim_light.name: Pilgrim Light
paladin_pilgrim_light.description: A slow visible orb heals the first allied unit it reaches.

miner_pickfall.name: Pickfall
miner_pickfall.description: Armor-chipping pick strike leaves a short vulnerability debuff.

miner_faultline.name: Faultline
miner_faultline.description: Warning line erupts in stone after a delay and briefly slows enemies.

miner_lantern.name: Deep Lantern
miner_lantern.description: Place a lantern that reveals the local ground and grants allies resistance.

miner_orehide.name: Orehide
miner_orehide.description: Blocking damage builds a small temporary mineral shield.

miner_mountain.name: Heart of the Mountain
miner_mountain.description: A warned stone ring rises to protect allies and constrain enemy movement.

golem_granite_fist.name: Granite Fist
golem_granite_fist.description: Large rocky golem slams a warned cone and generates tank threat.

golem_ether_anchor.name: Ether Anchor
golem_ether_anchor.description: Anchor an enemy briefly within a visible stone circle.

golem_construct_core.name: Construct Core
golem_construct_core.description: Incoming damage slowly charges the selected golem role resource.

golem_worldstone.name: Worldstone Awakened
golem_worldstone.description: Temporary ether overgrowth amplifies the selected tank, support or bruiser function.

golem_moss_bloom.name: Verdant Bloom
golem_moss_bloom.description: Mossy rock opens a warned healing garden for allies.

golem_living_granite.name: Living Granite
golem_living_granite.description: Apply a moss-covered shield to an ally; effective healing restores a portion.

golem_fel_fist.name: Felfire Fist
golem_fel_fist.description: Fel-flamed golem punches through a short cone of enemies.

golem_ether_furnace.name: Ether Furnace
golem_ether_furnace.description: Consume stored ether to empower a short sequence of basic attacks.

chieftain_axe_hook.name: Chieftain Hook
chieftain_axe_hook.description: An axe hook pulls the first unprotected target a short distance.

chieftain_banner.name: Blood-Oath Banner
chieftain_banner.description: Plant a destructible banner that bolsters nearby allies.

chieftain_courage.name: Unbroken Clan
chieftain_courage.description: Nearby allies grant the chieftain a capped resilience bonus.

chieftain_earthshout.name: Earthshout
chieftain_earthshout.description: Large delayed shout taunts enemies and shields allies in a visible circle.

behemoth_totem_sweep.name: Totem Sweep
behemoth_totem_sweep.description: Elephant-rhino hybrid swings its massive totem through a warned cone.

behemoth_tusk_line.name: Tuskbreaker
behemoth_tusk_line.description: A heavy line charge stops at solid collision.

behemoth_totem_bulwark.name: Totem Bulwark
behemoth_totem_bulwark.description: Brace the massive totem as a temporary destructible barricade.

behemoth_ancestral_weight.name: Ancestral Weight
behemoth_ancestral_weight.description: Standing still briefly increases resistance and threat retention.

behemoth_stampede.name: Ancestral Stampede
behemoth_stampede.description: Warned spectral stampede crosses a broad ground lane.

drakish_dragon_oath.name: Dragon Oath
drakish_dragon_oath.description: Timed dragon form grants exactly two cleaving slash attacks, then breathes a weak fireball toward the furthest valid enemy to gain ranged threat; returning to human sword/shield form ends the sequence.

drakish_scale_guard.name: Scale Guard
drakish_scale_guard.description: Brief dragon-scale defense protects the sword-and-shield footman.

drakish_wing_rebuke.name: Wing Rebuke
drakish_wing_rebuke.description: Warned wing sweep knocks nearby enemies away from allies.

drakish_ember_memory.name: Ember Memory
drakish_ember_memory.description: The weak threat fireball applies a short, minor burn; no full damage-spell scaling.

drakish_ancient_pact.name: Ancient Pact
drakish_ancient_pact.description: Extend one dragon transformation with a visible landing circle and group guard.

troll_axe_frenzy.name: Axe Frenzy
troll_axe_frenzy.description: Rapid dual-axe melee sequence with a visible commitment window.

troll_blood_leap.name: Bloodbound Leap
troll_blood_leap.description: Leap to a warned location and cleave on landing.

troll_hunger.name: Berserker Hunger
troll_hunger.description: Missing health grants a capped attack-speed bonus.

troll_red_moon.name: Red Moon Frenzy
troll_red_moon.description: Brief ultimate empowers the selected melee or thrown dual-axe form.

troll_twin_throw.name: Twin Throw
troll_twin_throw.description: Launch two visible axes with independent collision and hit limits.

troll_returning_axes.name: Returning Axes
troll_returning_axes.description: Recall thrown axes along warned return lanes; each target has a bounded hit count.

dryad_root_snare.name: Root Snare
dryad_root_snare.description: Warned roots hold enemies inside a small ground circle.

dryad_seed_mend.name: Seed Mend
dryad_seed_mend.description: Plant a healing seed on an ally that blooms after a short delay.

dryad_thorn_line.name: Thornweave
dryad_thorn_line.description: A visible thorn line slows enemies crossing it.

dryad_green_covenant.name: Green Covenant
dryad_green_covenant.description: Effective healing builds a small, capped regeneration reserve.

dryad_grove_renewal.name: Grove Renewal
dryad_grove_renewal.description: Grow a visible sanctuary of healing trees for living allies.

whisp_guiding_mote.name: Guiding Mote
whisp_guiding_mote.description: Send a visible healing mote to the first allied unit in its path.

whisp_spirit_tether.name: Spirit Tether
whisp_spirit_tether.description: Short-range healing tether breaks immediately outside its range.

whisp_fey_trail.name: Fey Trail
whisp_fey_trail.description: Leave temporary luminous ground motes that restore allies on contact.

whisp_lantern_soul.name: Lantern Soul
whisp_lantern_soul.description: Remaining near an injured ally improves resource regeneration.

whisp_constellation.name: Kindred Constellation
whisp_constellation.description: Visible links pulse healing to nearby living allies; no revival.

centaur_grove_javelin.name: Grove Javelin
centaur_grove_javelin.description: A root-tipped javelin harms enemies and leaves a small healing bloom.

centaur_trailblaze.name: Evergrove Trail
centaur_trailblaze.description: A warned forward path grants allied movement speed.

centaur_herd_call.name: Herd Call
centaur_herd_call.description: Call a temporary spectral grove companion with a bounded lifetime.

centaur_steady_gait.name: Steady Gait
centaur_steady_gait.description: Briefly moving without damage strengthens the next effective heal.

centaur_spring_march.name: Spring March
centaur_spring_march.description: A moving grove aura sustains allies during a short formation advance.

keeper_dawn_beam.name: Dawn Beam
keeper_dawn_beam.description: A warned light line heals allies and lightly damages enemies.

keeper_lantern_ward.name: Lantern Ward
keeper_lantern_ward.description: Place a destructible ward that grants a small allied shield pulse.

keeper_beacon.name: Beacon of Return
keeper_beacon.description: Mark an allied rally point with a visible ground beacon and short haste buff.

keeper_last_light.name: Last Light
keeper_last_light.description: A low-health ally can receive one small emergency shield per cooldown.

keeper_sunrise.name: Sunrise Vigil
keeper_sunrise.description: A broad, clearly warned radiance restores living allies over time.

polymorphed.line: Turned into a harmless critter: cannot attack or cast. Damage breaks it.
polymorphed.name: Polymorphed

armor_broken.line: Armor shattered by a Decimating Strike.
armor_broken.name: Armor Broken

executioner_ready.line: Your next basic attack is lethal (bosses excepted; champions lose 30% max health).
executioner_ready.name: Executioner Ready
